examples.english: Marcus Campion was a man of exceptional talent.
examples.persian: مارکوس کمپیون مردی با استعدادی استثنایی بود.

miniContext: Exceptional means unusually good.

meaning: برجسته، مشهور (معمولاً به خاطر مهارت در حرفه‌ای)

examples.english: He had been one of the most eminent lawyers of his generation.
examples.persian: او یکی از برجسته‌ترین وکلای نسل خودش بود.

miniContext: Someone who is eminent is famous and respected, often for being good at a profession.

examples.english: He was not a conventional lawyer, though.
examples.persian: با این حال، وکیل متعارفی نبود.

miniContext: Conventional means tending to follow what is done or considered acceptable by society in general.

examples.english: He had a reputation for defending men and women accused of the most brutal crimes.
examples.persian: شهرت داشت در دفاع از متهمان وحشیانه‌ترین جرم‌ها.

miniContext: Brutal means violent and cruel.

examples.english: This Mabbutt is a bizarre character.
examples.persian: این مبت آدم عجیب‌وغریبی است.

miniContext: Bizarre means very strange and unusual.

examples.english: I haven't formed a wholly favourable impression of him.
examples.persian: هنوز تصور کاملاً مطلوبی از او پیدا نکرده‌ام.

miniContext: Favourable means making people have a good opinion of sb/sth.

examples.english: I'm still reluctant to accept he might've killed his own children.
examples.persian: هنوز بی‌میلم بپذیرم ممکن است بچه‌های خودش را کشته باشد.

miniContext: Reluctant means hesitating before doing sth because you don't want to do it or you are not sure it is the right thing to do.

examples.english: Campion had defended wicked men in the past.
examples.persian: کمپیون در گذشته از مردان شرور دفاع کرده بود.

miniContext: Wicked means bad and morally wrong.

examples.english: This was a most disturbing case.
examples.persian: این یک پرونده‌ی بسیار آزاردهنده بود.

miniContext: Disturbing means making you feel anxious and upset or shocked.

examples.english: She wrote a book about a notorious criminal.
examples.persian: او کتابی درباره‌ی یک مجرم بدنام نوشت.

miniContext: If someone or something is notorious, they are famous for being bad.

examples.english: The economic situation in this country is not really comparable to China.
examples.persian: وضعیت اقتصادی این کشور واقعاً قابل‌مقایسه با چین نیست.

miniContext: Comparable means similar to another thing, situation or person, and able to be compared to it.

examples.english: I've produced a comparative analysis of the two social care systems.
examples.persian: یک تحلیل تطبیقی از دو سیستم مراقبت اجتماعی تهیه کرده‌ام.

miniContext: Comparative means connected with studying things to find out how similar or different they are.

examples.english: They walked in bare feet along the beach.
examples.persian: با پاهای برهنه در امتداد ساحل راه رفتند.

miniContext: Bare means (of a part of the body) not covered by clothes.

examples.english: It's a deadly snake.
examples.persian: این یک مار کشنده است.

miniContext: Deadly means causing or likely to cause death.

examples.english: There was a deathly silence in the room.
examples.persian: سکوتی مرگبار در اتاق حاکم بود.

miniContext: Deathly means like a dead person; suggesting death.

examples.english: I need a comprehensive list of the hotels.
examples.persian: به یک فهرست جامع از هتل‌ها نیاز دارم.

miniContext: Comprehensive means full, and including all necessary details.

examples.english: It's a comprehensible story.
examples.persian: این داستان قابل‌فهمی است.

miniContext: Comprehensible means able to be understood.

examples.english: This model is superior to the others.
examples.persian: این مدل از بقیه بهتر است.

miniContext: Superior means greater or better in quality than sth/sb else.

examples.english: My sister's behaviour is very childish.
examples.persian: رفتار خواهرم خیلی بچگانه است.

miniContext: Childish (disapproving) means behaving in a silly way.

examples.english: It's a very tasteful room.
examples.persian: این اتاق خیلی خوش‌سلیقه چیده شده است.

miniContext: Tasteful means (of clothes, furniture, etc.) attractive and of good quality.
